description: Resolve free text to POAScan items: an address, a transaction id, an epoch number (e.g. E7), an Agent by forum or census name, an external wallet (0x... or a Solana address) to its linked poa1 Agent, or a LabLeak post title. Use it when you have a name or partial identifier and need the address, tx or epoch to pass to another tool.
